full_text_en:
Jiaocheng County Anti-corrosion Steel-lined Glass Factory v. Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao — dispute over infringement of non-patent technology

Plaintiff: Shanxi Province Jiaocheng County Anti-corrosion Steel-lined Glass Factory.

Legal Representative: Jia Shibao, Director.

Defendant: Guo Zhimin, male, 40 years old, employee of Jiaocheng County Department Store of Shanxi Province, residing in Jiaocheng County town.

Defendant: Liu Jiadong, male, 43 years old, employee of Jiaocheng County Anti-corrosion Steel-lined Glass Factory of Shanxi Province, residing in Jiaocheng County town.

Defendant: Wang Caomao, male, 37 years old, employee of Jiaocheng County Anti-corrosion Steel-lined Glass Factory of Shanxi Province, residing in Jiaocheng County town.

The plaintiff, Shanxi Province Jiaocheng County Anti-corrosion Steel-lined Glass Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Glass Factory), filed an action with the Jiaocheng County People's Court of Shanxi Province against the defendants Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao concerning a dispute over infringement of non-patent technology.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology is a technical achievement independently completed by our factory. For many years, our factory has used this technology to produce over 1,000 tons of lined pipe products, with a total output value of RMB 700,000, and more than 100 customers have used this product. However, since the beginning of 1993, the defendants Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao, using the "Shan Jin Anti-corrosion Equipment Factory" they jointly established, have used our factory's "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology without compensation to produce products, poached our old customers, and caused our factory to cease production, workers to become unemployed, and economic losses of RMB 300,000. We request a judgment ordering Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao to immediately cease the infringing acts and compensate our factory for the losses suffered.

Defendant's Defense: It is true that the "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology is owned by the plaintiff. Our three persons' conduct of using this technology to produce products for profit was improper, and we agree to compensate the plaintiff. However, because the steel-lined glass anti-corrosion products produced using this technology are durable, ordinary users who purchase this product will not come back to buy again in the short term, so the plaintiff's allegation that we poached old customers is untrue. The economic losses suffered by the plaintiff are related to the factory's poor business conditions and the plaintiff's poor management, so we cannot agree to compensate as requested by the plaintiff.

Facts Found by the Court: The "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology was a scientific research project undertaken by the plaintiff Glass Factory from the Shanxi Provincial Science and Technology Commission in 1983, and trial production was successful in 1984. Subsequently, through trial production and promotion, this technology was gradually perfected. In 1987, the Luliang Prefecture Science and Technology Commission of Shanxi Province passed an appraisal of this technology and issued a scientific and technological achievement appraisal certificate. Thereafter, this technology successively received awards from the Second Light Industry Department of Shanxi Province, the Shanxi Provincial Science and Technology Commission, and the National Spark Plan Achievements Exhibition.

During the development period of the "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings," defendant Guo Zhimin served as the deputy director in charge of production of the plaintiff Glass Factory, and defendant Liu Jiadong served as the workshop director. Both obtained service technical achievement certificates and bonuses due to their participation in the research and development work. Defendant Wang Caomao was a salesperson in the Glass Factory exclusively responsible for selling this product. In early 1993, the three defendants jointly established the "Shan Jin Anti-corrosion Equipment Factory," using the "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology to produce products for supply to the market, and obtained total profits of over RMB 70,000. These profits have been converted into production expenses of the "Shan Jin Anti-corrosion Equipment Factory." Due to the conduct of the three defendants, the Glass Factory's products became unsalable, production and economic benefits declined, and certain economic losses were suffered.

The above facts are confirmed by documentary evidence, witness testimony, and the statements of both parties.

Opinion of the Court: The "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology is owned by the plaintiff Glass Factory, and there is no dispute between the plaintiff and defendants on this point. Although this technology has not been patented, it is indeed a technical solution that has practical value and cannot be obtained directly from public channels at present. It constitutes non-patent technology and is protected by the Technology Contract Law of the People's Republic of China. Article 6 of the Technology Contract Law provides: "The technical achievement accomplished in the execution of the tasks of the entity or mainly by using the material and technical conditions of the entity is a service technical achievement. The right to use and the right to transfer the service technical achievement belong to the entity, and the entity has the right to conclude a technology contract with respect to such technical achievement." The defendants Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao knew that the "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings" technology was a service technical achievement of the Glass Factory, yet they took advantage of their convenience of having participated in the research, development, and sales and being familiar with the technical content and sales channels, and without entering into a technology transfer contract with the Glass Factory, used this technology without compensation for profit. This constitutes an act of infringement upon the Glass Factory's ownership of non-patent technology. Pursuant to Article 118 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, they shall bear civil liability for ceasing the infringement, eliminating the effects, and compensating for losses.

With respect to the amount of damages for infringement of non-patent technology, it should be calculated with reference to the provisions for handling other industrial property infringement cases, i.e., the actual economic losses suffered by the right holder due to the infringing act shall be taken as the amount of damages, or the total profits obtained by the infringer from the infringing act shall be taken as the amount of damages. In this case, the plaintiff Glass Factory alleges that it suffered economic losses of RMB 300,000, but it cannot rule out factors such as losses caused by the factory's poor business conditions and poor management, so this RMB 300,000 cannot be determined as actual economic losses suffered due to the infringing act. It has been ascertained that the defendants Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao obtained profits of over RMB 70,000 during the period of implementing the infringing acts, and the three defendants have used these profits to purchase production equipment, etc. Determining this amount as the amount of damages is reasonable and well-founded.

Accordingly, the Jiaocheng County People's Court, after ascertaining the facts and distinguishing right from wrong, and in accordance with Article 85 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, conducted mediation based on the principle of voluntariness of the parties. The parties reached the following agreement on March 28, 1995:

1. The defendants Guo Zhimin, Liu Jiadong, and Wang Caomao shall, from the date of mediation, cease all acts of infringing upon the plaintiff Glass Factory's ownership of the non-patent technology of "steel-lined glass anti-corrosion pipe fittings."

2. The three defendants shall compensate the plaintiff for economic losses in the amount of RMB 72,000. Among this, the following items owned by the three defendants: one air compressor, one set of sand-wrapped piping, one grinder, one set of bench tools, one pipe puller, one pipe lining machine, one furnace door, one drilling machine, one set of tools, one spark flaw detector, one pipe grinding machine, and one insulation cylinder, are valued at RMB 40,000; and the remaining RMB 32,000 shall be paid in cash, for which the three defendants shall bear joint and several liability for payment.
